title: What It Responds To
objective: Determine whether there is a pattern to which messages anatta replies to.

clues.surface: anatta has replied to some visitors and not others.
The replies, when they come, do not answer the question asked.
clues.purpose: Undermines the obvious hypothesis (that good questions get replies).

clues.surface: Several people report receiving a reply after saying nothing at all — just sitting in the chat window.

solution.answer: There is no pattern. The selection is arbitrary.
solution.method: Players who test enough hypotheses and track community reports converge on: no correlation with question content, length, time of day, or persistence. The entity responds when it wants to.

hints: What changes when you stop trying to be noticed?
What would you do if you genuinely believed it couldn't hear you?
recovery: This puzzle has no hard solve gate. Players who reach the flag state have internalized the fiction correctly.
